name: GigaBrain Challenge 2026 World Models Track Dataset
summary: 用于轨迹条件视频生成和闭环 VLA 交互评测的多任务、多视角视频与状态轨迹数据。
summaryEn: Multi-task, multi-view video and state-trajectory data for trajectory-conditioned video generation and closed-loop VLA evaluation.
scale: Multiple tasks with train, video-quality, and evaluator splits
scaleZh: 多个任务，包含训练、视频质量和评测器划分
licenseZh: 仓库采用 Apache-2.0；数据许可见发布页
access: Dataset and leaderboard available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 数据集和排行榜已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 同时覆盖训练、开放环生成和闭环交互评测的数据基准
verdictEn: A dataset benchmark spanning training, open-loop generation, and closed-loop interaction
wmNote: 拆分设计便于区分视频生成质量与闭环智能体能力。
wmNoteEn: Its splits separate video-generation quality from closed-loop agent capability.

evidence.sourceTitle: World Model Track Guide | GigaBrain Challenge 2026
evidence.statement: Official track supplies manipulation trajectories and evaluates generated world-model videos as VLA evaluators. Data access requires an agreement.
